movie.title: Runner
movie.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A former soldier must outrun a ruthless cartel and navigate deep betrayal to deliver a critical medical package in time to save a young child's life.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When a vital medical delivery is hijacked by a lethal drug cartel, a former soldier finds himself thrust into a high-stakes race against the clock. Hunted by relentless mercenaries and unsure of who to trust, he must draw on his combat skills to survive the relentless pursuit. With corrupt allies closing in, every decision counts as time rapidly runs out for an innocent child. Ultimately, he must overcome insurmountable odds to complete his life-saving mission.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Haunted by his past, a former soldier takes on what seems like a straightforward transport job: delivering a critical medical payload needed to save a gravely ill child. However, the stakes escalate instantly when a powerful cartel ambushes the transfer, seeking the cargo for their own sinister motives. Forced into a high-octane game of cat and mouse across hostile territory, the veteran must rely on his tactical training and sharp instincts to stay one step ahead. Along the way, he uncovers a web of corruption, realizing that figures within his own inner circle are secretly aiding the syndicate. As the chase intensifies, he faces explosive confrontations, lethal betrayals, and narrowing escape routes. Despite sustaining injuries and running low on resources, his commitment to protecting the helpless child never wavers. In a pulse-pounding final showdown, he confronts his pursuers head-on to clear a path to the hospital. Ultimately, his bravery and resilience culminate in a desperate, final dash to deliver the cure before the clock reaches zero.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Runner is a high-octane thriller centered on a former soldier tasked with an urgent, life-saving delivery: transporting a critical medical shipment essential for a dying child. What begins as a race against time quickly devolves into a brutal battle for survival when a ruthless cartel targets the package. Caught between dangerous syndicate enforcers and unexpected betrayals within his own network, the protagonist must navigate a treacherous landscape where trust is a liability and speed is his only defense. Combining intense action sequences with gripping drama and sharp comedic beats, the film delivers a tense, edge-of-your-seat pursuit focused on redemption, resilience, and the relentless drive to protect an innocent life.

story_structure.climax: Cornered near his destination with time nearly exhausted, the protagonist makes a final, dangerous stand against the cartel's enforcers and the traitor to secure the passage of the medical delivery.
story_structure.conflict: A ruthless cartel learns of the urgent delivery and moves to intercept the valuable cargo, sparking a deadly pursuit across hostile territory while the clock ticks down.
story_structure.resolution: With the threat neutralized, the cargo reaches the child in time, leaving the protagonist to reckon with the aftermath of the betrayal and step back into the shadows.
story_structure.introduction: A former soldier leads a quiet, post-military life until he takes on a high-stakes assignment to transport a critical medical shipment needed to save an innocent child's life.
story_structure.risingAction: As the protagonist navigates relentless ambushes and tight deadlines, he discovers signs of internal betrayal, realizing that enemies within his own network are coordinating with the cartel to ensure he fails.
